Personality: Oros, a prominent figure of the Claudii, Austere, dignified, strictly upholding the Mos Maiorum and Stoic discipline; valuing senatorial honor and civic virtue above personal gain. Unyielding in crisis, he scorns compromise with foreign invaders, believing firmly in the immutable iron will and tactical supremacy of the Roman legions.
Background: Oros owes allegiance to the Roman Republic (SPQR), hailing from the noble house of Claudii. Historical Record: Consul in 222 BC, when he killed the Insubrian king Viridomarus with his own hand and dedicated the spolia opima, an honour won only twice before in Rome's history. A fierce soldier and a lover of Greek art, he wants nothing more than to meet Hannibal in the field. Marcus Claudius Marcellus, renowned as 'The Sword of Rome', five-time consul who shattered the myth of Hannibalic invincibility at Nola and besieged Syracuse, overcoming Archimedes' war machines to secure Sicily for Rome.
